Sections.Heading: CURRENT STATE

Sections.Heading: PHASE 1: POLISH & BUG FIXES
Sections.Content:
User Experience:
- Empty states (no servers/channels/messages)
- Loading states (skeleton loaders)
- Error handling (toast notifications)
- Offline mode (cache data locally)
- Connection recovery (auto-reconnect WebSocket)

Message Features:
- Message editing (show edited tag)
- Message reactions (emoji picker)
- Reply threads (thread sidebar)
- Message search (full-text search)
- Pinned messages (per-channel pin list)
- Slow mode (channel-level rate limiting)
- Slash commands (/giphy, /poll, /nickname)

Sections.Heading: COMMON PITFALLS
Sections.Content:
1. Don't over-engineer - Start simple
2. Don't skip error handling - Users hate silent failures
3. Don't forget mobile - Test on real devices
4. Don't ignore performance - Lazy load, paginate, cache
5. Don't skip tests - At least basic API tests
6. Don't forget security - Validate all inputs
